title: Xing-Audio-NVVASR: Scaling and Refining Supervision for Joint Recognition of Speech and Non-Verbal Vocalizations
abstract: arXiv:2611.26000v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Joint recognition of speech and non-verbal vocalizations (NVVs) is hindered by scarce event-rich training data and inaccurate or missing event labels. We present Xing-Audio-NVVASR, an end-to-end recognizer trained through progressive data mining and iterative supervision refinement. Guided by unified acoustic criteria, two heterogeneous models cross-audit annotations, flagging disagreements for teacher reannotation. To uncover shared omissions that model agreement may conceal, complementary breath detectors screen the entire corpus for human review. Human-confirmed labels accumulate across rounds and are preserved during subsequent refinement. Over five rounds, we refine annotations for 170,000 utterances from public corpora and incorporate 630,000 mined utterances. translated_title: Xing-Audio-NVVASR：扩展与精炼监督以实现语音与非言语发声的联合识别
translated_abstract: 语音与非言语发声（NVVs）的联合识别受到事件丰富训练数据稀缺以及事件标签不准确或缺失的阻碍。我们提出了Xing-Audio-NVVASR，这是一个通过渐进式数据挖掘和迭代监督精炼训练的端到端识别器。在统一的声学标准指导下，两个异构模型对标注进行交叉审计，标记出不一致之处以供教师模型重新标注。为了发现模型之间一致性可能掩盖的共同遗漏，互补的呼吸检测器对整个语料库进行筛选以供人工审核。经人工确认的标签在各轮之间不断积累，并在后续精炼过程中得以保留。经过五轮迭代，我们对来自公共语料库的17万条话语进行了标注精炼，并纳入了63万条挖掘出的话语。所得的约80万条话语语料库被用于训练一个单一的17亿参数模型，该模型以行内标签转录语音，涵盖六类NVV。
tldr: 该论文提出Xing-Audio-NVVASR，通过渐进式数据挖掘与迭代监督精炼构建了约80万条话语的语料库，训练出17亿参数的端到端模型，实现带行内标签的语音与非言语发声联合识别。
en_tdlr: This paper presents Xing-Audio-NVVASR, an end-to-end recognizer that builds a corpus of ~800K utterances through progressive data mining and iterative supervision refinement to train a 1.7B-parameter model for joint recognition of speech and non-verbal vocalizations with inline tags.
